question.prompt: What is the sum of all integer solutions of the system of inequalities \(\{2x-1>3,\ x-5\leq0\}\)?

solutions.explanation: The first inequality gives \(x>2\), and the second gives \(x\leq5\). The solution set is \(2<x\leq5\). The integer solutions are 3, 4, and 5, whose sum is 12.
solutions.title: Find and sum the integer solutions
